race.description: In Loving Memory Of Helen Haywood Showcase Hcp (C1)
race.comment: CHOC CHIP (10) won her maiden first-up then skipped straight to a Class 2 and was probably looking for more ground when sixth over 1200m at Wagga last start. Back to a Class 1 over an extra 200m which looks a nice set-up for this sparingly raced mare. CENTRAL OTAGO (4) returned from an eight-month break with a dominant all-the-way win in a 1300m Wagga maiden last time out. Has only been to the races four times so there is plenty of improvement to come. Will prove tough to reel in again. SHAPENAPIT (2) led for a long way but found one better last start over 1300m at Bendigo when lining up for the first time under new trainer Paul McVicar. Given a 40-day let-up so may need this but is still an each-way hope. KENNY'S SWANS (1) is a genuine gelding who looks ready for a first try at 1400m. KENDALIA (3) is racing well without winning. Nice one to throw in the exotics.
